title: purple-mimi 4: skeleton plugin
description: Skeleton (docs/design/purple-mimi.md §13 step 4), in the new repository MarkAtwood/purple-mimi (GPL-3.0-or-later; created only after Mark's review of the design): Cargo workspace (purple-mimi-core, safe; purple-mimi-ffi, staticlib, the only unsafe), CMake calling cargo, cbindgen header; core: tokio runtime on its own threads, the process-wide event queue and its pipe, accounts, the state lock and takeover (§6), the live-stream connection and its errors (§7); ffi: process and account functions with catch_unwind (§5.5); both the libpurple 2 and libpurple 3 glues load, connect, disconnect and report errors; CI on Linux and Homebrew macOS. About 3,600 to 4,900 lines (estimate).
notes:
2026-11-22: step 4 landed in purple-mimi at b745894 (pushed). Built and verified: cbindgen header committed with ci/check-header.sh; CMake calling cargo, both plugins linking; purple2 and purple3 glues compiling clean with -Wall -Wextra against real headers (libpurple 2.14 from Debian trixie, libpurple 3 2.98.0 built from the Pidgin 3 alpha tarball in ci/purple3.Containerfile); symbol hiding verified by ci/check-exports.sh (only purple_init_plugin, only GPlugin's three, out of a 220 MB staticlib); headless smoke test passes, with a real libpurple loading prpl-mimi beside IRC and XMPP and unloading cleanly; ci/check-mimid-patch.sh; COPYING and NOTICE; .github/workflows/ci.yml.

Three design corrections found by compiling, all recorded: mimi_account_info renamed to mimi_account_get_info (a C typedef and a function cannot share a name; §5.5 updated); libpurple 3 2.98.0 has no account username so the MIMI user is a 'user' account setting; libpurple 3's PurpleConnectionError lacks AUTHENTICATION_FAILED, NAME_IN_USE and INVALID_USERNAME so those map to CUSTOM_FATAL.

NOT done, deliberately: THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES (cargo-about at release time per §10.2); the cargo-deny licence allow list; the libpurple 3 headless host and its smoke test (mimid-s4oy.10's scope); the CI workflow has not been run by GitHub yet. purple-mimi still pins mimid at 41babcc9.
